about: A chip of BN5's whose code moved into BN6's engine (issue #82's C3): BN5's field 0x73 (lava at columns 2 and 5 of row 2) as BN6's (xpanels.c's lava), BN5's CanladEX held paralysed (hold: each game's own status step, the same bits in both) at (4,2), MegaMan made Fire in both (mm_element) on lava at (2,2) with a folder of ElemRage E in both games, BN5's chip 128 by BN5's own code and the registry's 455 by the same code moved (BN5's family 0x56 as BN6's 0xA6: its element by MegaMan's panel, lava's Fire, BN5's type 8 BN6's 13 in its table), the first Custom screen's chip picked and OK, used at t30: every difference of BN6's play from BN5's fails it (docs/multirom/chips-code.md).
